notes: Pure PROC OPTMODEL (SAS/OR): trains a 2-hidden-layer sigmoid neural network by nonlinear optimization. Declares weight vars, impvar forward-pass expressions and L1/L2 regularization terms, minimizes a least-squares-plus-regularization loss, solves with NLPU tech=lbfgs, and prints the fitted weights. Fully self-contained (hyperparameters via %let, no external data, no libnames, no paths) so it runs byte-for-byte unmodified. autoexec adds only options obs=100. Deterministic across repeated runs (objective 0.2569166584).
